webhooks.detail: HTTP integrations fire requests to external URL on ticket events (ticket_created, ticket_updated, ticket_message_created, ticket_status_updated, ticket_assignee_updated, etc.), HMAC-signed.

evidence.quote: Events that will trigger the request to the external service.

sandbox.detail: Sandbox via developer portal; needs draft app and approval; new sandboxes are Demo accounts, email techpartners to switch to Developer plan. Free not stated.

evidence.quote: Currently all new Sandbox accounts are Demo accounts by default.

rate_limits.summary: Leaky bucket: 40 req/20s (API key), 80 req/20s (OAuth2 apps); Enterprise uses 10s window; 429 + Retry-after

evidence.quote: The Gorgias API is rate-limited using a leaky bucket algorithm, meaning that the number of requests you can make in a period of time is limited, but replenishes.
No SDK mentioned in the Gorgias developer docs index (llms.txt).
